categories.main_business_segments: Hana Pharm Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sale of ethical pharmaceuticals, focusing on narcotic analgesics and anesthetics for severe pain management. The company also manufactures cardiovascular drugs, analgesics, gastrointestinal medicines, neurological and dermatological pharmaceuticals, with a portfolio of approximately 360 health insurance-listed products. It operates manufacturing plants in Hwaseong and an R&D center in Pangyo.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including KGMP, EU-GMP, and cGMP standards. It employs specialized production methods such as Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) for PP ampoules, isolated freeze-drying facilities for sterile products, and automated packaging and labeling systems. R&D focuses on drug delivery systems, sustained-release formulations, and chemical synthesis for new and improved drugs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hana Pharm serves hospitals, including large general and university hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies across South Korea. Its main customers are medical institutions requiring narcotic analgesics and anesthetics, with stable demand from anesthesiology departments. The company also targets cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, neurological, and dermatological treatment markets, with products prescribed by physicians.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within South Korea, with manufacturing facilities in Hwaseong and an R&D center in Pangyo. It holds exclusive licenses and distribution rights for certain products in Southeast Asian countries including Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Singapore, and Malaysia. Export activities include partnerships and contract manufacturing for markets such as Japan and other global regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hana Pharm operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and R&D of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage forms. It also engages in downstream activities including sales and distribution to hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies. The company manages procurement of raw materials both domestically and internationally and maintains contract manufacturing relationships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in next-generation pharmaceuticals addressing chronic and intractable diseases linked to aging populations. Key innovation areas include new chemical entities like remimazolam, MRI contrast agents, targeted anticancer drugs, and drug delivery technologies. Hana Pharm actively pursues open innovation, government-supported projects, and global licensing-in/out agreements to expand its drug pipeline and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Hana Pharm generates revenue primarily through the sale of ethical pharmaceutical products to medical institutions and pharmacies. Revenue streams include domestic sales of narcotic analgesics, anesthetics, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and other specialty drugs, as well as export sales and licensing income from technology transfer agreements. The company also earns royalties from licensed products in Southeast Asia.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in narcotic analgesics and anesthetics within South Korea, competing with a few other manufacturers in a highly regulated and oligopolistic market. It ranks among the top domestic pharmaceutical companies by sales, with competitors including major Korean firms like Yuhan, GC Pharma, and Daewoong. Hana Pharm differentiates itself through specialized product lines and strong hospital relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Hana Pharm reported annual revenues of approximately 224.5 billion KRW, reflecting a 6.5% year-over-year increase. Operating profit declined by 13.3% to 27 billion KRW due to raw material cost increases and exchange rate fluctuations. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt ratio around 25.3% and a net profit margin near 9.9%. It continues to invest in expanding production capacity and R&D to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hana Pharm emphasizes its leadership in narcotic analgesics and anesthetics with high market share products that have significant entry barriers due to strict regulation. Its broad portfolio of over 360 health insurance-listed ethical drugs covers multiple therapeutic areas, enabling comprehensive treatment options. The company leverages advanced manufacturing facilities, strong R&D capabilities, and exclusive licensing agreements to deliver high-quality, innovative pharmaceuticals with stable supply and proven efficacy.
